subject: CSV export not completing for large date ranges

When I try to export a report covering more than 3 months of data, the export job hangs and eventually times out. Smaller date ranges work fine. We need this for our year-end reporting so would appreciate a fix soon.

Ville Møller

body:

Kristina Holm

The large export problem I raised two weeks ago (ticket from Dec 11) seems to be back. I thought it was fixed but ran another year-end extract today and it timed out again at the same point. This is holding up our closing process. Can someone look at this properly this time?

Ville Møller

body:
We deactivated two users in February and I was expecting to see that reflected in our next invoice, but the seat count hasn't changed. Can you confirm how the billing cycle works for mid-month deactivations? I'd also like to understand when we'd see the credit, if any.

Kristina Holm

subject: Export failures - third time raising this

I've raised this before in December and again in late December. Export jobs for anything over a few months of data are still failing. We've had to work around it by splitting exports manually, which takes significant extra time every reporting cycle. I don't understand why this keeps coming back. Please escalate if needed.

Ville Møller

I checked spam folders - nothing there. This is a problem because these alerts are part of our monitoring process and people are relying on them. Please look at this urgently.

Kristina Holm

Ville Møller

subject: Export format question
body:

Kristina Holm

subject: Connector refresh timing
body: Is there a way to see exactly when the connector last refreshed successfully? Would help us confirm the numbers are current before we send reports out.

body: We're hiring a second financial controller. Please add a new Standard seat once they start next month - I'll confirm the exact date closer to time.

body:
I'm trying to apply conditional formatting (color scale) to a field that's part of a group-by, but the formatting only applies to the total row, not the individual rows within the group. Is there a way to make it apply to all rows? If it's a known limitation I'd appreciate knowing so I can design around it.

Astrid Salminen

body:
Our Snowflake connector started throwing an authentication error this morning: 'JWT token expired'. We haven't changed any credentials. I've regenerated the key pair and updated the connector but still getting the error. What else should I check?

Nils Halvorsen

I have an alert set to trigger when our pipeline error rate exceeds 5%. Yesterday it hit 12% and no alert was sent. The alert shows as active in the system. Can you investigate? This kind of silent failure defeats the purpose of having alerts.

Astrid Salminen

Our main data connector stopped syncing as of June 23rd. There's no error in the connector logs, it just shows 'last synced: 2 days ago' and never updates. I've tried refreshing credentials and re-saving the connector config. Nothing works. This is blocking our reporting team.

Nils Halvorsen

Astrid Salminen

Nils Halvorsen

Nils Halvorsen

Astrid Salminen

subject: Export recipient limit

subject: Password reset for locked account

subject: Alert not respecting business hours
